newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Light to submit Black Point report.
newsitem.headline: China Light to submit Black Point report.

text.p: China Light & Power Co Ltd said on Tuesday it would submit a report to the government on Wednesday on the deferral of the second phase of its Black Point power plant.
"China Light & Power will submit a report to the government tomorrow explaining the company's situation," Jimmy Lui, general manager, distribution and customer services, told reporters.

The Hong Kong government asked China Light last November to submit a report on the cost of deferring units five to eight of the Black Point plant after an independent consultant's report recommended a halt or delay in the commissioning of four of the plant's eight units.
Black Point consists of eight 312-megawatt units, two of which were commissioned in mid-1996 and two due to be switched on in mid-1997.
The remaining four were due to be turned on at a rate of one a year until 2001.
Lui would not give details of the contents of the report.
